record.notes: First proposed by China at WAIC in July 2025. Signed in Shanghai on 16 Jul 2026 by representatives of 29 countries, which became founding members; Foreign Minister Wang Yi signed for China, and named signatories include Kazakhstan, Laos, Pakistan, Russia and Indonesia. The Agreement remained open for signature until 31 Jul 2026; Georgia's ambassador signed it in Beijing on that day. The Agreement describes WAICO as an independent intergovernmental international organization that follows the purposes of the UN Charter. The WAIC 2026 Chair's Statement (17 Jul 2026) reports the signing and says WAICO shall be open to all countries.

verification.note: Stored MFA page on the signing ceremony (updated 16 Jul 2026) confirms the exact title, the 16 Jul 2026 signing in Shanghai, the 29 founding signatories, the Shanghai headquarters and the stated purposes. The stored WAIC 2026 Chair's Statement (MFA, 17 Jul 2026) confirms the signing. A stored page of the Embassy of Georgia in China (31 Jul 2026) confirms Georgia's signature on 31 Jul 2026 and that the Agreement was open for signature until that day. None of the pages gives the treaty text, its authentic languages, or entry-into-force and ratification conditions, so 'Adopted, not yet in force' is provisional. The July 2025 proposal date in the notes is not in the stored pages. Region 'Global' is used because this is a multilateral instrument, although China initiated it.

record.issuing_body: Signatory governments (29 founding members; open for signature until 31 Jul 2026); signing hosted by China in Shanghai

title.quote: Signing Ceremony of the Agreement on the Establishment of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization Held in Shanghai

date_published.quote: On July 16, 2026, the signing ceremony of the Agreement on the Establishment of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization was held in Shanghai.

status.quote: signed the agreement, with these countries becoming founding members of the Organization
WAICO will be the world's first intergovernmental international organization on AI, with its Headquarters located in Shanghai.
The founding ceremony of the Organization was held on July 16, 2026, during which the Agreement was signed by representatives of 29 countries.

issuing_body.quote: Representatives of 29 countries, including Kazakhstan's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development Zhaslan Madiyev
Foreign Minister Wang Yi attended the ceremony and signed the agreement on behalf of the Chinese government.
The Agreement remained open for signature until July 31, 2026.

On July 31, 2026, in Beijing, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Georgia to the People's Republic of China, Paata Kalandadze, signed the Agreement on the Establishment of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization.

legal_force.quote: The Agreement specifies that the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization is an independent intergovernmental international organization that follows the purposes of the UN Charter

judgment.status_reasoning: Latest events in the stored files: signature in Shanghai on 16 Jul 2026 by 29 countries, which became founding members (MFA page); further signature by Georgia in Beijing on 31 Jul 2026, the last day the Agreement was open for signature (Georgian embassy page). The Chair's Statement of 17 Jul 2026 says WAICO 'will be' the first intergovernmental organization on AI. No stored page quotes an entry-into-force clause or reports any ratification or deposit. A treaty founding an intergovernmental organization, signed and closed for signature, is adopted. With no entry-into-force event or rule in the stored text, the status as of 14 Oct 2026 is 'Adopted, not yet in force', and date_in_force stays null. This is provisional until the treaty text or a depositary notice is stored.
judgment.scope_reasoning: In scope without a scope note: an intergovernmental treaty founding an international organization for AI governance whose stated aim includes the 'safe' development of AI.
